name: Oragon
summary: Oragon features a matte white marble top that brings a calm, polished elegance to the piece. The body and short legs are wrapped in dark grey matte elm veneer, adding texture and a rich contemporary tone. The back and inner panels are finished in melamine for a clean, refined interior. A single tall leg in brass metallic paint introduces a warm accent, giving the design a balanced, modern sophistication. Top with White Marble(Matte), the body and two short legs cover with elm veneer in dark grey matt. the back and inner panels with melamine. The high leg paint in brass metallic. 120×43.5×75
